viewing_check: Check the 1915 grade and that it is genuine (date and no cleaning or damage), and the 1921M for true grade (aUNC vs EF). Confirm the three 1950s coins are really unc (no wear on wheat ear/ crown) and not cleaned. Note the cards are old so check for toning or rubbing.
